mailer_templates_confirmation_content:
Confirm your VerdictGames account using the link or one-time code.

VERDICT.games

Welcome to VerdictGames

Confirm your email to start saving games, building collections and sharing your verdicts. The confirmation page will ask you to continue before signing you in.

Confirm email

Prefer to stay in your signup tab? Enter this code there, even if you read this email on another device:

{{ .Token }}

This link can be used once and expires according to our account security settings. If it has expired, request a new link from VerdictGames.

If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

{{ .RedirectTo }}&flow=confirmation#token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}

If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email. VerdictGames will never ask you to send your password by email.

Your next game starts with a verdict.
mailer_templates_recovery_content:
Your one-time VerdictGames password recovery code.

VERDICT.games

Choose a new password

Enter this code in the VerdictGames recovery form, then choose a new, unique password. You can read this email on any device.

{{ .Token }}

This code can be used once and expires according to our account security settings. Use the latest email. If it has expired, request a new code from VerdictGames. Never share your code.

Need to reopen the recovery form? This page does not verify the code or change your password:

{{ .SiteURL }}/reset-password

If you did not request this, ignore this email. Your password has not changed. VerdictGames will never ask you to send your password by email.

Your next game starts with a verdict.
